返回值语言，取值：

- zh-CN：中文。

- en-US：英文。
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese.

- en-US: English.

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value on the client. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
The ID of the GTM instance.

description.zh: 实例名称，方便区分实例的业务用途。
description.en: The name of the instance. This helps you identify the business purpose of the instance.

description.zh: 当前页数，起始值为**1**，默认为**1**。
description.en: The page number. The value starts from **1**. The default value is **1**.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值**100**，默认为**20**。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is **100**. The default value is **20**.
